headline: We document characters, capture stories and explore worlds.
description: Toy Boat is a full-service film production team. We set out to navigate the open waters of storytelling, capturing authentic narratives from unique perspectives. We explore the personalities and creative expressions that define a subject, believing that the best stories aren’t just crafted—they’re discovered.
location: Based in Poulsbo, serving the Puget Sound
aboutText:
Toy Boat is me, Andrew Tomayko. I’ve been telling stories with a camera for more than 20 years, sometimes as part of amazing crews, sometimes as a one-man band. Along the way I’ve directed, shot and edited just about every kind of project: commercials, documentaries, music videos and films for brands I love.

After a decade in Los Angeles, I traded the city for solitude on the high seas. These days I live aboard my sailboat in the Puget Sound, and that love of adventure carries into my work. Whatever the project, I look for the real characters and genuine moments that make a story worth telling, because the best stories aren’t just crafted — they’re discovered.
